records.name: Keepers of the Earth Fund (Cultural Survival)
records.what: Grants of up to 12,000 US dollars that go straight to Indigenous communities, collectives, organizations and traditional governments for projects they design themselves. Groups without government registration can apply.
records.who: Indigenous communities and groups in any country.
records.start: Read the fund's page and watch for its yearly call for proposals.

records.name: UN Permanent Forum on Indigenous Issues
records.what: The United Nations advisory body on Indigenous peoples' issues: development, culture, environment, education, health and human rights. It meets each year in New York, where Indigenous peoples' organizations can take part.
records.who: Indigenous peoples and their organizations everywhere.
records.start: Read about the Forum and how to take part in its yearly session.
